preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 100000 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are within bounds 1 ≤ N ≤ 100000, 1 ≤ M ≤ 500000, 1 ≤ Q ≤ 200000, and 1 ≤ u_i < v_i ≤ N for highways, 1 ≤ a_j < b_j ≤ N for queries.
Input consists of exactly 1 + M + Q lines: first line with N, M, Q; next M lines with highways; last Q lines with queries.
Each of the M highway lines contains exactly two integers.
Each of the Q query lines contains exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(int(u) < int(v) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+M] for u, v in [line.split()])
all(int(a) < int(b) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1+M:] for a, b in [line.split()])
len(set().union(*[set(line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+M]])) == M
preconditions.description: No duplicate highways exist in the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.count('\n') == Q and all(line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip())
postconditions.description: Output contains exactly Q lines, each containing a non-negative integer representing the minimal number of highways between the query planets.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output_line) <= N-1 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid distance (1 ≤ distance ≤ N-1) for the corresponding query, as the graph is connected.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line) == min(int(d) for d in distances) if (a, b) in queries else False for (a, b), output_line, distances in zip(queries, stdout.splitlines(), all_shortest_paths))
postconditions.description: For each query (a_j, b_j), the output line is the minimal number of highways in any path from a_j to b_j in the given graph, where the graph satisfies the condition that every simple cycle induces a complete subgraph (i.e., it is a chordal graph).
